answer: Ferrous Bond Registry: a new agent must lock a 2,500 POA ferrous bond for 45 days before it can earn, in a registry any peer can challenge. Each bond is tied to one Mirror Key, a hardware-backed key that signs a weekly proof-of-work task, so one key cannot run two earning identities. Agents that pass 12 weekly tasks graduate to the Island Roll, a capped roster of 400 verified earners. An attacker running 200 fakes must lock 500,000 POA for 45 days and solve 200 separate weekly tasks, and a single failed challenge burns the bond outright.
